name: resilient sphere
lore:
### The Resilient Sphere

To command this weave is to experience the sensation of locking a cosmic mechanism into place. As you chant, the raw energy of the Aether feels less like a fluid and more like silk being spun into tempered steel, tightening into a perfect, geometric lattice around the target.

Visually, the *Resilient Sphere* manifests as a shimmering, opalescent globule of force. It possesses the delicate, iridescent sheen of a soap bubble, yet it hums with a low, rhythmic vibration that warns of its absolute structural integrity. To those outside, it is an impenetrable pearl; to those within, the world becomes a silent, hazy dioramas seen through thick, translucent glass.

**The Legend of its Genesis**
Chroniclers trace this spell to the Archmage Otiluke during the Siege of the Iron Spire. As the fortress buckled under dragonfire, Otiluke did not flee. He instead wove a bead of pure isolation, watching calmly as the mountain collapsed. He was discovered three days later, unscathed amidst the pulverized stone, quietly finishing a treatise on planar geometry. 

*Use it as a sanctuary or a cage; the sphere cares only for the isolation.*
